name: Guangdong Haomei New Materials Co.,Ltd
summary: Guangdong Haomei New Materials Co.,Ltd researches, develops, manufactures and sells aluminum profiles in China. The company offers automotive lightweight materials, including anti-collision beams, battery trays, shock absorber brackets, power brackets, by-frames, and motor housing products. It also provides doors and windows systems; aluminum alloy building profiles; and industrial aluminum and forging products, including machined and round bar, and extruded aluminum square tube. The company's products are used in traffic, electronic communication, infrastructure, woodworking machinery, high-end equipment, and mechanical and electrical fields.
